Pages.title: 杏仁树
Pages.text: 生长所需条件：$(br)$(bold)$(l:tfc:core_mechanics/climate#temperature)温度$(): -6°C - 36°C$(br2)树苗等待时长以物品提示为准，受配置调整；须在活动月份满足温湿度才会转枝，枝叶还需继续生长。结果期右键树叶采果，采后遵守TFC开花冷却。$(br2)北半球开花月：2、3；结果月：6、7。南半球由TFC换季。$(br2)坚果提供蛋白质，可直接食用，也可作汤、沙拉和三明治配料。加工须用未腐烂原料，遵守原版工具和容器规则。

Pages.title: Almond Tree
Pages.text: Conditions required for growth: $(br)$(bold)$(l:tfc:core_mechanics/climate#temperature)Temperature$(): -6°C - 36°C$(br2)Check the sapling tooltip for its configured wait. Conversion to a branch also needs an active month and suitable climate; branch growth takes additional time. Right-click fruiting leaves to pick; TFC bloom cooldown still applies.$(br2)Northern flowering months: 2, 3; fruiting months: 6, 7. TFC shifts seasons in the south.$(br2)These protein foods can be eaten or used in soup, salad and sandwiches. Use fresh ingredients and native tools/containers.
